{"summary": "The mgmt cluster has no critical or high CVEs in the digest. The main risks are the Argo CD "platform" project with wildcard destinations, sources and cluster resources, and the argocd-manager ServiceAccount bound to cluster-admin. Other findings are low-severity hardening gaps (seccomp, immutable filesystem, unpinned revisions). Node and control-plane CIS checks were not run.", "targets": ["mgmt"], "frameworks": [{"name": "NSA", "passed": 14, "failed": 6, "skipped": 6, "score": 75}, {"name": "MITRE", "passed": 12, "failed": 4, "skipped": 6, "score": 80}, {"name": "Trivy PSS", "passed": 16, "failed": 1, "skipped": 0, "score": null}], "findings": [{"severity": "HIGH", "title": "Argo CD 'platform' project is unrestricted (wildcard destinations, sources, all cluster resources)", "resource": "AppProject/platform", "controls": [], "evidence": "The digest shows project "platform" with wildcard_destination:true, wildcard_sources:true and all_cluster_resources:true, and app "alloy" uses it.", "fix": "kubectl -n argocd patch appproject platform --type merge -p '{"spec":{"destinations":[{"server":"https://kubernetes.default.svc","namespace":"<ns>"}],"sourceRepos":["<repo-url>"],"clusterResourceWhitelist":[{"group":"<g>","kind":"<k>"}]}}'", "confidence": "high"}, {"severity": "MEDIUM", "title": "argocd-manager ServiceAccount bound to cluster-admin", "resource": "ClusterRoleBinding/argocd-manager (ServiceAccount kube-system/argocd-manager)", "controls": [], "evidence": "The digest lists binding "argocd-manager" with role cluster-admin and subject "ServiceAccount:kube-system/argocd-manager".", "fix": "Replace cluster-admin with a scoped ClusterRole covering only the kinds Argo CD manages: kubectl delete clusterrolebinding argocd-manager, then create a narrower ClusterRole and binding.", "confidence": "medium"}, {"severity": "LOW", "title": "cluster-admin bound to system:masters group (likely platform default)", "resource": "ClusterRoleBinding/cluster-admin", "controls": [], "evidence": "The digest lists binding "cluster-admin" with subject "Group:/system:masters". This looks like the Kubernetes default binding.", "fix": "No change needed. Restrict who can obtain system:masters credentials, for example the admin kubeconfig.", "confidence": "medium"}, {"severity": "MEDIUM", "title": "Argo CD root app uses the default project and tracks HEAD", "resource": "Application/root, Application/alloy", "controls": [], "evidence": "The digest shows app "root" in project "default" at revision "HEAD", and app "alloy" at revision "main".", "fix": "Move root into a restricted AppProject and pin targetRevision to a tag or commit SHA: spec.source.targetRevision: <tag-or-sha>", "confidence": "medium"}, {"severity": "MEDIUM", "title": "Seccomp profile not set on workloads", "resource": "2 workloads (not named in digest)", "controls": ["Trivy PSS 10"], "evidence": "Trivy PSS control "10" (Seccomp) failed with fails:2.", "fix": "securityContext:

(mount emptyDir volumes for any paths that need writes)", "confidence": "high"}, {"severity": "LOW", "title": "Medium vulnerabilities and low misconfigurations in trivy k8s scan", "resource": "mgmt cluster images", "controls": [], "evidence": "The digest shows vuln_counts MEDIUM:8 and misconfig_counts LOW:4, with critical_high_vulns empty.
